svg.title: Slingshot — Astrophage: an infected sun, the Petrova line and a fuel knot
svg.desc: Planning mockup (Astrophage): the sun is infected, a Petrova line runs to Venus, the planned path crosses a fuel knot, the Astrophage map is on and the fuel block shows the Astrophage row with its planning ghost.
